title: Identification of immune-related biomarkers linked to systemic lupus erythematosus and dilated cardiomyopathy through integrated bioinformatics analysis and multiple machine learning algorithms.
summary: Cross-disease machine-learning analysis prioritized HERC6 and IFI44L for SLE-related cardiomyopathy, with external data and cell assays as checks.
ai_technology: GEO expression sets, feature selection and external evaluation support the nomogram; qPCR tested selected genes in a doxorubicin cell model.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Cross-disease machine-learning analysis prioritized HERC6 and IFI44L for SLE-related cardiomyopathy, with external data and cell assays as checks.
evidence.unknown: The candidate biomarkers come from existing GEO datasets; external datasets and qPCR check diagnostic associations but do not establish causal links between SLE and cardiomyopathy.
evidence.ai_role: GEO expression sets, feature selection and external evaluation support the nomogram; qPCR tested selected genes in a doxorubicin cell model.
